No: ELVUANActivation/2025 Date: 28.03.2025

To,

Employers of all establishments covered under EPFO

Subject: UAN Activation and seeding Bank Account with AADHAAR for availing the
benefits under ELI Scheme- Extension up to 30th April, 2025 regarding.

References:
EPFO Head Office Circular no: ELI/UAN/Activation/2024 Dated 22.11.2024
EPFO Head Office Circular no: ELI/UAN/Activation/2024 Dated 04.12.2024
EPFO Head Office Circular no: ELI/UAN/Activation/2024 Dated 20.12.2024
EPFO Head Office Circular no: ELI/UAN/Activation/2025 Dated 06.02.2025
EPFO Head Office Circular no: ELI/UAN/Activation/2025 Dated 21.02.2025
Madam/Sir,

You may kindly refer the subject and circulars mentioned above.

Please refer to the circulars mentioned under references. In this connection, the
competent authority has granted an extension of timeline for UAN Activation and
AADHAAR seeding in Bank Account till 30th April, 2025

[This issues with the approval of Competent Authority]

(Dr Anil O
Addl. Central PF Commissioner-HQ (Compliance)

Copy to:
a. PPS to CPFC for information.
b. PS to FA&CAO/ACC(HQs) for information.

c. All Zonal Heads/Regional Heads are requested to make necessary efforts to achieve
the Target by launching a special Drive/holding of camps in clusters having high

pendency.

d. ACC(HQ),C&PR Division--With request for wide publicity for achieving 100% UAN
Activation and AADHAR Seeding of Bank Account.

e. All Officers/Staff (through EPFO website)
f. ACC HQdS) with request to place this circular in the Employer and Member Portal

g. Web-admin for uploading on EPFO website.
